bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 50 (Thursday, March 21, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. SOTO:
H.R. 7788.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, of the United States Constitution.
The single subject of this legislation is:
The bill would set up a Firefighter's Compensation fund for
firefighters or their families to claim compensation for
illness or death caused by their exposure to PFAS through
their profession.
[Page H1354]
